scope: training-source grouped cross-validation diagnostics; no new deployment or independent-test claim
outer_folds: same fixed 5 training-group folds as Round12
inner_group_order: sort 96 non-outer groups then numpy default_rng(seed+fold).permutation; first24 calibration, remaining72 nested fit order
pca: fit-only base-weighted StandardScaler then weighted covariance eigendecomposition; 16/64 components; no whitening or post-PCA standardization
layer_mean28: raw layer-major 28x28 attention heads, average head axis then fit-only standardization
learning_curve: 24 subset of48 subset of72 fit groups; same24 calibration and24 evaluation; rescale loss weights to full72 token count to hold total loss mass constant
thresholds: each method/fold selected only on24 calibration groups by F1, then precision, then larger threshold; no method selection on outer scores
diagnostics: posthoc per-fold oracle-threshold upper bound, never used as deployable result
label_review: 30 training asserted answers;3 old-risk and3 old-nonrisk per category with distinct groups; seeded, anonymized, blinded to old labels and detector scores; no relabeling for training
